description: TAI/GPS/TT scale offsets vs UTC at canonical epochs. Validates lib/time (Push 2b) — TAI-UTC exercises the leap-second table; TT-TAI and TAI-GPS are the definitional offsets.

provenance.reference: IERS Bulletin C historical TAI-UTC steps; IAU/IERS definitional offsets TT-TAI=32.184 s and TAI-GPS=19 s
provenance.note: Values are independent of the Polaris implementation (published constants); GMAT reproduces the same conversions and can regenerate this fixture.
